generator.role: typed ontological compiler from a frozen research specification to a constitution, execution matrix, and claim lattice
generator.authority_rule: The generator may expose underspecification and mechanically enforce the research constitution, but code execution does not itself grant scientific truth. Theory and implementation are co-evolving authorities with explicit non-implications.

budget_atlas.interpretation: The outcome-blind atlas is not a budget-invariant state identity at the fine quotient. Coarse K2 structure is substantially more stable than K8, while K8 changes materially as node budget increases.
budget_atlas.claim_ceiling: No threshold was prospectively declared for a stability pass/fail. These are descriptive measurements, but they defeat any unqualified claim that the P24/P25 K8 atlas is search-budget invariant.

causal_replication.interpretation: P24's architecture-index necessity replicated on a fresh exact-world population. The result is stronger than a single-state mismatch: at K8 every engine realizes eight distinct state-conditioned law signatures, yet no state is architecture-free across all three engines.

descriptor_morphism.interpretation: Two frozen source descriptors are sufficient to separate the three observed law signatures, but every sufficient two-coordinate map induces three singleton engine classes. P25 therefore identifies a finite-set descriptor factorization without earning nontrivial law-family compression.
descriptor_morphism.identification_ceiling: This is descriptive sufficiency on three admitted engines. It is not a causal estimate of any descriptor's effect and cannot identify a population-level minimal architecture coordinate.

engineering_incidents.effect: The in-memory atlas_receipts map used integer budget keys. Python sorted them numerically when hashing, but written JSON converted them to strings and later sorted them lexicographically. All vertex jobs stopped at P25_PRECOMMIT_HASH before any selective engine call.

The identical sealed world/census/atlas prefix was reloaded and re-sealed through JSON normalization. The repaired precommit survived a fresh parse, selective execution then completed, and JavaScript independently recomputed the scientific branch logic.

claim_ceiling: Architecture identity remains an index for the observed law family; P25 does not prove that engine name is fundamental rather than a proxy for unmeasured mechanism coordinates.

The fine K8 atlas is budget-sensitive over the tested node range, so law statements indexed by its states are coordinate-and-budget constituted unless a later transport construction removes that dependence.
The two-coordinate descriptor result is finite-set separation, not causal identification of architecture features.
No learned or outcome-optimized alignment was introduced after outcomes.
